top_signals.title: Indonesia Halts Jakarta, Lampung Flights on Volcano Eruption
top_signals.summary: Indonesia suspended flights at airports in Jakarta and Lampung on Sunday after volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatau spread across parts of Java and Sumatra, according to state-owned airport operator InJourney Airports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
